title: 800 Flaky Tests Walk Into a Bar
excerpt: Flaky tests aren't flaky. They're the only honest people in the building.
body:
When I migrated a legacy suite to Playwright, everyone called the failures 'flaky'. Flaky sounds random. It almost never is.

Most of them were the app telling the truth: a race between a spinner and a button, a network call nobody awaited, a selector that matched two things on a slow day.

Fixing the waits, not adding retries, is what stabilised 800+ tests. Retries just teach a suite to lie politely.
